messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "tell doctor about history of heart disease"
set: ["tell doctor about history of heart disease", "tell doctor about history of recent heart attack", "tell doctor about history of liver or kidney disease", "tell doctor about history of narrow-angle glaucoma", "tell doctor about history of long QT syndrome", "inform doctor of history of liver disease", "inform doctor of history of kidney disease", "tell doctor about history of bipolar disorder (manic depression)", "tell doctor about history of bleeding or blood clotting disorder", "tell doctor about history of drug addiction or suicidal thoughts", "tell doctor about vitamins", "tell doctor about minerals", "inform doctor about history of allergies or asthma", "tell doctor about thoughts about suicide", "tell doctor if have history of diabetic retinopathy", "tell doctor if have congestive heart failure or liver disease"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
